target: ALL 259 sensor-labelled GPS or GNSS archived original source packages; preserve unchanged 437 registry denominator.
goal: Systematically identify original CSV-format column support across the full source frame before expanding GPS macroecological outcomes, without selecting based on published or previously measured animal effects.
file_selection: For each source, enumerate ORIGINAL bundle metadata; exactly ONE non-reference .csv, .csv.gz or .zip candidate required for automatic header route. Multi-primary originals remain ambiguous and are NEVER silently reduced to one. No replacement of a chosen source after any result.
byte_policy: For one plain .csv only, byte-capped HTTP initial-range preview (<=8192 bytes) is used solely to parse FIRST header line; event values are not parsed, stored or logged. Original checksums must be verified for all later full GPS analyses, not a header claim.
network: Public original DSpace bitstream content endpoint only, 30s request timeout. HTTP errors retained. 8 concurrent providers max; no login, authentication bypass or alternate-host substitution.
size_policy: Plain original CSV above 120MB is marked full-transfer-size HOLD but is still counted as a file with known metadata. ZIP or gz primary file is COMPRESSED_PENDING_ORIGINAL_MD5_AND_SCHEMA not declared bad.
result: Every original package UUID retained with candidate count, metadata status, header parse status, original schema column support, original source study IDs and provenance; NO animal rows, exact positions, timestamps or trajectories distributed.
cannot_identify: A header indicates potential schema only; cadence, sun-azimuth coverage, actual GMT attestation, permitted behavioral inference, and original study independence cannot be verified from a header.
